decisions.reason: The source changes persistent hover-help label behavior, not whether placeholder text clears automatically when a field is activated.
The source concerns interactive field help labels and does not change bullet appearance or formatting.
Retaining a help label after field content changes does not alter the requirement to preserve Title field formatting.
The source does not address legacy-content migration, pasted-content layout, or style stability.
The source defines the relationship between field content and hover-help labels but does not select or modify the mechanism used for ordinary fill-in prompts.
Hover-help labels can coexist with grey visual input cues; the source does not replace the grey appearance or resolve its password-protection conflict.
The source does not concern pasted-content overflow or page-margin containment.
Interactive field help-label behavior does not change table paste stability or right-column boundaries.
The source may apply help labels to checklist fields through the source Requirement's scope, but it does not change the checklist control type or behavior.
The source may apply help labels to dropdown fields through the source Requirement's scope, but it does not change the dropdown control or its document assignment.
The help-label rule does not modify the calendar-style date input method.
The source does not address manual line-break entry after pasting legacy content.
